question: A spherical ball of radius 24 cm is melted and recast into identical hemispheres, each having a radius of 8 cm. Determine the combined curved surface area of all hemispheres.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of radii (R/r) = 24/8 = 3

Number of hemispheres (n) = 2 × (R/r)³ = 2 × 3³ = 54

CSA of one hemisphere = 2πr² = 2π × 8² = 128π

Combined CSA = 54 × 128π = 6912π cm²

**∴ Answer = 6912π cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of Sphere (R) = 24 cm

Radius of Hemisphere (r) = 8 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of Sphere = (4/3) × π × R³

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hemisphere = 2 × π × r²

 
• R=24 Sphere

• r=8 n = 54 Hemispheres Total CSA = 6912π cm² 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of hemispheres (n) = Volume of Sphere ÷ Volume of Hemisphere

⇒ n = [(4/3) × π × 24 × 24 × 24] ÷ [(2/3) × π × 8 × 8 × 8]

⇒ n = 2 × (24/8) × (24/8) × (24/8) = 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 = 54

⇒ CSA of one hemisphere = 2 × π × 8² = 2 × π × 64 = 128π

⇒ Total Combined CSA = 54 × 128π

⇒ Total Combined CSA = 6912π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
